description: Post-workout summary: when the 'compared with last time' rows are shown. Implemented by isVsLastComparable on Android; iPhone must produce identical results.
rule: Shown only when previousSetCount > 0 and currentSetCount * 100 >= previousSetCount * 80 (the workout logged at least 80% of the previous workout's sets). Otherwise the comparison is hidden entirely, so an incomplete workout never shows a large negative change. previousSetCount is the logged set count (reps > 0) of the latest earlier workout that shares an exercise with the finished one; 0 when there is none.
